responsibility: Implements token rendering and keyword initialization for the D lexer/parser layer. It maps token kinds and literal tokens back to printable text, pools identifiers for reserved keywords, and initializes the token-to-string table used by diagnostics, pretty-printing, and AST rendering.
same_name_distinction: Implements token text rendering, keyword table initialization, and token object allocation/recycling for the token types declared in gcc/d/dmd/tokens.h. Unlike the header, it populates Token::tochars, builds the reserved-word mapping, and defines Token methods rather than the TOK/EXP vocabulary itself.
